purpose: Complete the already-scheduled 6 September 2026 OPEC+ voluntary-adjustment review using a tightly bounded reputable-newswire fallback because the competent OPEC primary outcome statement was not retrievable on the accessible/indexed primary surface at review time. Preserve the missing-primary condition explicitly and prohibit forward-schedule creation from the fallback.

target.canonical_name: OPEC+ voluntary-adjustment review — seven participating countries

completion_source.endpoint_role: Completion-only secondary verification of the 6 September 2026 OPEC+ voluntary-adjustment review when the competent primary outcome statement is not retrievable
completion_source.information_supplied: Reuters reports that the seven participating OPEC+ countries met on 6 September 2026 and, citing the group's statement, kept October output policy unchanged. Used only to establish that the scheduled review occurred; not primary OPEC provenance and not forward schedule authority.
completion_source.future_schedule_horizon: post-event fallback completion only; no future occurrence may be created from this source
completion_source.recommended_verification_cadence: none; replace or supplement with primary OPEC provenance when retrievable
completion_source.licence_constraints: No Reuters article text is stored or republished; only minimal factual attribution, URL and the reviewed lifecycle proposition are retained.
completion_source.rights_summary: BE makes no claim of broad Reuters reuse or automated retrieval rights. The source object governs one manually reviewed fallback provenance use only.
completion_source.rights_review_note: Operational WORLD SIGNALS source-governance classification; not legal advice.
known_limitations: Reuters is a reputable secondary newswire, not the competent OPEC primary source.
At BE review time the accessible/indexed OPEC press-release surface did not expose the 6 September outcome statement; this absence is not evidence that no statement exists.
Reuters says the group acted 'in a statement', so primary OPEC provenance should replace or supplement this fallback when retrievable.
The Reuters-reported 4 October next-meeting date is not admitted to Canonical by BE.
No article text, market attribution or forward policy inference is retained.
completion_source.notes: Completion-only fallback provenance. WSSRC-COM-001 remains the governed OPEC schedule/decision authority. BE does not downgrade that primary authority and does not create a future occurrence from secondary reporting.

completion_basis.status_history_reason: Existing scheduled OPEC+ occurrence marked completed after reviewed post-event fallback verification. Reuters reports that the seven-country group met on 6 September and says the unchanged October policy was announced in a group statement. Completion is not inferred from elapsed time. The competent OPEC primary outcome statement was not retrievable on the accessible/indexed primary surface at review time and remains a provenance-upgrade requirement.
